name: kaola-workflow-gitea
description: Gitea edition of Kaola-Workflow for Codex, driven by an adaptive, resumable mission list, using Gitea issues, pull requests, tea, and repo-backed workflow artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive mission-list Kaola-Workflow for Gitea projects
interface.longDescription: Kaola-Workflow Gitea for Codex exposes repo-backed skills and Codex-native agent profiles for project initialization, workflow-init, and adaptive, resumable execution: the orchestrator writes a mission list of items, reads the frontier, dispatches subagents when useful, and closes items as their results land, through research, planning, TDD execution, review, documentation docking, and finalization against Gitea issues and pull requests.
defaultPrompt: Use Kaola-Workflow Gitea for Codex in this repo.
Resume the current Kaola-Workflow Gitea project.
Run workflow-init for Kaola-Workflow Gitea for Codex.
